title: Hallucination in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Survey on Causes, Corrections, and Evaluations
abstract: arXiv:2410.15359v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal Foundation Models represent a significant leap in artificial intelligence. Among them, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) serve as the typical representative of these foundation models, which integrate visual modality directly into Large Language Models (LLMs). They have demonstrated strong capabilities in information processing and generation. However, the existence of hallucinations has limited the potential and practical effectiveness of LVLM in various fields. Although lots of work has been devoted to hallucination mitigation and correction, there are few reviews to summarize them. To address this gap, this survey provides a systematic review of the hallucination landscape in LVLMs. We categorize the causes related to model architecture and data quality, and construct a comprehensive taxonomy of existing mitigation strategies. translated_title: 多模态基础模型中的幻觉：关于成因、纠正与评估的综述
translated_abstract: 多模态基础模型代表了人工智能领域的重大飞跃。其中，大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）作为这类基础模型的典型代表，将视觉模态直接融入大型语言模型（LLMs）之中，在信息处理与生成方面展现出强大的能力。然而，幻觉现象的存在限制了LVLM在各个领域的潜力和实际应用效果。尽管已有大量工作致力于幻觉的缓解与纠正，但很少有综述对其进行总结。为填补这一空白，本综述对LVLMs中的幻觉现状进行了系统性回顾。我们将幻觉的成因归纳为与模型架构和数据质量相关的因素，并构建了现有缓解策略的全面分类体系。此外，我们还从不同角度批判性地评估了当前的幻觉评估基准。
tldr: 本文是一篇系统性综述，全面梳理了大型视觉语言模型中幻觉的成因（模型架构与数据质量）、构建了缓解策略的分类体系，并批判性评估了现有的幻觉评估基准。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), categorizing its causes related to model architecture and data quality, constructing a comprehensive taxonomy of mitigation strategies, and critically assessing current evaluation benchmarks.
